Relevant references will be in the footer of the slide. # Git and GitHub Basics ## About Git Git is a version control system ::: subpoint ○ Originally made for software developers to manage large codebases ::: "Manages the "manages the evolution of a set of files---called a **repository** or **repo**---in a sane, highly structured way." (Bryan, 2017, p. 2) Now often used for researchers to manage their coding / data work. ::: subsubpoint ○ Many of the functionalities map over well ::: ::: subsubpoint ○ We often have a collection of code files, figures, data, etc that can run rampant if untamed... ::: ::: footer [Happy Git with R: Why Git](https://happygitwithr.com/big-picture#why-git) and [Excuse me, do you have a moment to talk about version control?](https://peerj.com/preprints/3159v2/) ::: ## About GitHub What is GitHub? Why GitHub ## Getting Started GitHub account # Quarto Websites ## Quarto Websites So far, we've mostly been using Quarto documents (single HTML files). Today, we are going to make a Quarto website. What is a Quarto website? A Quarto website is just a way of organizing multiple Quarto documents. Instead of just having one page to scroll through, now we can have multiple. By default, will have navigation features set up to help move throughout your website. Why website instead of a document? Websites allow you to have more than one page. You can have a website with just one page if you want, and then you will always have the flexibility of adding more (e.g., a new analysis, a Quarto slide deck for a presentation) # Quarto on GitHub

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
